How GrindCTRL connects: your Shopify store (native app and theme blocks) sends products and read-only order status to GrindCTRL, where try-on, Store Chat, the team inbox and the dashboard are live. GrindCTRL hands conversations to your team with the reason and email alerts. n8n and HubSpot connect through custom setup.
